blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jaime Tan Cruz previously served as a special envoy to China for trade and investments under Vice President Sara Duterte’s father, former President Rodrigo Duterte’s administration. Cruz was earlier identified as an incorporator of the same businesses in which VP Sara Duterte declared holding shares. Cruz being former President Duterte’s envoy to China was confirmed by the House prosecution panel during the 28th day of Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial when asked by Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo.
